name: SDXL + Refiner
purpose: Two-pass SDXL generation: base model renders the composition, refiner pass adds detail and coherence.
caveats: Refiner uses separate CLIP encode — both positive prompts (nodes 6 and 15) must be updated together
Base runs steps 0-20, refiner runs 20-25 — adjusting step split changes style balance

context.summary: Best all-around workflow for high-quality photorealistic and cinematic images. Two-pass process with SDXL base + refiner produces sharp, coherent results.
context.prompt_guidance: Works great with descriptive photography-style prompts. Include lighting, mood, camera/film references. Juggernaut excels at realism and human subjects.
context.caution: Remember to set BOTH positive prompt nodes (6 and 15) to the same text, or base and refiner will diverge.
